Definition: from G4731; to solidify, i.e. confirm (literally or figuratively):--establish, receive strength, make strong.
BiblicalUsage: To make strong is what happened at the gate called Beautiful. The lame man's feet and ankle bones received strength, faith in the name made the man strong whom they saw and knew, and the churches were established in the faith and increased in number daily.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the strengthening is the same work in a body and in a church: the name of Jesus makes strong.
